answer: Identities climb a ladder of five rungs. Rung 1 needs a 100-token bond locked 14 days; each higher rung doubles bond and lock, and rung r may hold at most half as many agents as rung r-1. A crystal-clear honest agent climbs once, but a fake at the top forces about two fakes beneath it, so the delta in cost per extra fake keeps rising, from 3,100 tokens toward far more. Like velvet over rough stone, early rungs look cheap, yet validators replay signed bond and unlock records to enforce caps and slash cheaters.
